oracle_kind: Complete cumulative 19-task label file; includes original labels plus 196 post-run graded task-skill pairs. Do not append old pool again or fall back to preregrade oracle.jsonl.

calculation_rules.relevant: pool[].grade >= 2 matched by task ID and exact full skill ID including revision
calculation_rules.hit_denominator: Loaded sessions on tasks with at least one oracle grade >= 2; keep no-relevant-task loads separate. If all 19 tasks are loaded once, the eligible denominator is 17, not 19.
calculation_rules.unknown: Skills absent from this cumulative oracle, or with no grade, remain UNGRADED/null; count separately. Do not assign a grade, treat as grade 0, or reuse another task grade.
calculation_rules.precision: State denominators explicitly; preserve separate ungraded counts and graded-only precision. Comparing to Stage5 precision requires naming its per-session mean; do not silently equate it to micro precision.

codex_e2e_2_preservation.change: One qualifier line inserted under the existing follow-up section; every previous byte and all numbers preserved otherwise.
